# Sarkari Yojna

Sarkari Yojna is an independent platform that helps Indian citizens discover, understand, and apply for government schemes.

## Features
- Scheme Discovery
- Categorized schemes for central and state governments (Madhya Pradesh focus)
- Feedback and verified updates
